summary: This is an 8-K filed by Merrill Lynch Depositor, Inc. on behalf of PPLUS Trust Series GSC-2 reporting a routine distribution to certificate holders on May 15, 2026. The filing references the underlying securities held by the trust but provides no terms, no board recommendation, and no structural changes. It is a standard periodic distribution notice for an asset-backed security trust, not a special situation event. No action is required; this is a non-event for special-situations analysis.
